data.content_ref: inline:The target is circular in its reasoning regarding the premise 'Because daytime thermal mass storage is high, this trapped sensible heat is released slowly throughout the night, keeping the city air several degrees warmer.' It uses the presence of high daytime thermal mass storage as the reason there is heat available to release at night, yet then claims the single best mechanism is the reduction in effective sky view factor (SVF). The high thermal mass storage is not merely incidental; it is the primary causal source of the heat that keeps the city warmer at night, while SVF merely acts as a modulator on the rate of its release. Asserting that SVF is the single best mechanism when it relies on a separate mechanism (thermal mass storage) to supply the heat in the first place is logically circular, as SVF alone does not explain why the air is warmer if there is no stored heat to trap.
